audit.whatIsWrong: Four content strings call Mordekaiser's Q 'Mace of Spades (Q)'. The kit's real Q is Obliterate.
audit.why: Riot Data Dragon lists Q = Obliterate, 8/7/6/5/4s, 675 range, no cost. Mace of Spades is a retired name — same class of error as 'Ares of Blaze' for Pyroclasm.
audit.corrected: Obliterate (Q), 675 range, 8s at rank 1 down to 4s at rank 5.

audit.whatIsWrong: No page text carries the real ranges of his engage: Death's Grasp pulls from 700 on 16/14/12/10/8s, Obliterate reaches 675, and Realm of Death only reaches 650.
audit.why: Vayne's whole answer is spacing, and spacing advice without the numbers is unusable. Condemn is 550 range, so he out-ranges her step-up with both Q and E.
audit.corrected: Death's Grasp 700 / 16s at rank 1; Obliterate 675; Realm of Death 650 on 140/120/100s.

audit.why: The ownerKit tags Obliterate with grounding:'shuts off enemy dashes' but Riot's description says nothing of the sort — a tooltip-parse misfire. I wrote no claim that Obliterate denies Tumble; the mirror audit reached the same conclusion.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart reads Vayne, Vayne, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill in both layers; the audited Mordekaiser side reads Skill, Mordekaiser, Mordekaiser, Mordekaiser, Mordekaiser, Vayne, Vayne.
audit.why: The two directions must agree or mirror-fix.js overwrites this page. Mechanically the mirror is right: he out-ranges her at 675/700 through levels 2-6 and she takes over on her first crit item.
audit.corrected: All seven rows proposed as one atomic paired group to match the mirror.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[2].why sells level 3 as Vayne's pattern coming online while the same row now sits with Mordekaiser.
audit.why: Level 3 is his spike — full kit plus the Indestructible shield — and the row and its why must say the same thing.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to name Obliterate's 675 range, the Death's Grasp pull, and the shield.

audit.whatIsWrong: Indestructible's heal is never given a timing, so anti-heal reads as an optional buy.
audit.why: Indestructible stores damage dealt and taken and may be consumed to heal, on 12/11/10/9/8s. Grievous Wounds timing decides every extended trade.
audit.corrected: Executioner's Calling before extended trades; fight while his shield is spent.

edits.before: You kite his slow Mace of Spades (Q) and win the level-1 trade.
edits.after: Obliterate (Q) reaches 675 while you must walk to 550 to trade.

edits.before: At level 2 he still can't catch you without landing Death's Grasp (E).
edits.after: Death's Grasp (E) pulls from 700 into Obliterate and Darkness Rise.

edits.before: You reclaim the trade at 4-5 by spacing his cooldowns before his ult.
edits.after: Obliterate falls to 5s at rank 4 and Death's Grasp to 10s — no gaps.

edits.before: Kiting Mace of Spades (Q) and dodging Death's Grasp (E)
edits.after: Kiting Obliterate (Q) and dodging Death's Grasp (E)

edits.before: You win the opening levels kiting his slow Mace of Spades (Q) and Death's Grasp (E) pull, but level 3 is his window — with all his abilities and Indestructible (W) shield up he can walk you down and burst if you get pulled. Stay spaced, Condemn him when he E-pulls, and don't trade into his shield.
edits.after: The opening levels are about spacing Obliterate (Q) at 675 and the Death's Grasp (E) pull at 700, and level 3 is his window — full kit plus the Indestructible (W) shield walks you down if the pull lands. Stay outside 700, Condemn him into a wall when he E-pulls, and never trade into a fresh shield.

edits.before: You win the first two levels by kiting his slow Mace of Spades (Q) and spacing his Death's Grasp (E) pull. His threat is purely walk-up, so keep your distance and Silver Bolts punishes him whenever he steps up to farm.
edits.after: The first levels are spent kiting Obliterate (Q) at 675 and staying outside the 700-range Death's Grasp (E) pull. His threat is purely walk-up, so hold your distance and let Silver Bolts punish him whenever he steps up to farm.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Mordekaiser must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Level 3 is his — Obliterate at 675 plus the Death's Grasp pull and Indestructible shield beat your pattern. Hold the wave near you.

edits.before: Trade strictly around Realm of Death: when it is down, run your full pattern; when it is up, give nothing. If behind, farm safe and let your spikes re-open the lane.
edits.after: Indestructible turns stored damage into a heal on an 8-12s cycle, so buy Executioner's Calling before extended trades and only commit once his shield is already spent.

edits.before: AA-tumble-AA on Mordekaiser's step-up, proc the third silver bolt for true damage, and walk away before he reaches you.
edits.after: Realm of Death steals your stats and his damage is all magic — magic resist plus Executioner's Calling cuts both down.

edits.before: Mordekaiser wastes Realm of Death — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Death's Grasp pulls from 700 and is down 16s at rank 1 — punish the whiff.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: The pull sets up Obliterate, and Darkness Rise ramps in melee.

notes: Left alone deliberately: spikes[1].text, spikes[3].text and mid all claim QSS answers Realm of Death. I cannot verify from the kits whether QSS or Cleanse removes Realm of Death, and the kit's needsResearch is empty (meaning unknown, not no) — recorded in unverified rather than edited. Also: Realm of Death is 650 range, shorter than most players assume, and 140/120/100s — worth a future edit if the QSS question is resolved.
